cues.en: The TLDR covariance is best interpreted with normally distributed data and only measures linear interactions.

cues.en: So here is the formula for covariance between two variables X and y.

cues.en: Now you do need to make sure both variables are mean centered.
cues.zh: 不過，必須確保兩個變數都經過平均中心化，

cues.en: Otherwise there can be a bias introduced by the mean offsets between the variables.

cues.en: Now this bias by the mean offset actually is a desired result for cosine similarity, but for covariance

cues.zh: 與相關而言，我們不希望平均值偏移引入系統性偏誤。

cues.en: And scaling by n minus one is a normalization factor that prevents the covariance term from just trivially increasing by having more and more data.
cues.zh: 除以 n−1 是一種正規化因子，避免資料越來越多時，共變異數也只是跟著自然增加。

cues.en: Now the reason why you subtract one and not just divide by n has to do with the degrees of freedom of
cues.zh: 為什麼要減 1，而不是直接除以 n，則與共變異數分析的自由度有關，
